settings.heading: Settings
settings.intro: They apply only to your user.
settings.coloursHint: Applies at once to every page.
settings.reportingHint: Used for the totals when you look at several accounts together.
settings.passwordIntro: At least {{min}} characters. After the change the other sessions are logged out.
settings.passwordDone: Password changed. The other sessions were logged out.
settings.logoutOthers: Log out from the other devices
settings.exportHint: A CSV file with every field; it can be imported again as it is.
settings.aboutHint: Version, AGPL v3 licence and source code.

errors.NOT_AUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Please log in again.
errors.CSRF_CHECK_FAILED: The request was blocked for security reasons. Reload the page and try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: Not found: it may have been deleted meanwhile.
errors.CURRENCY_LOCKED: The currency cannot change: the account already has transactions.
errors.SETUP_ALREADY_DONE: This installation is already set up: log in.
errors.CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH: The name you typed does not match the account name.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: The password must be at least 12 characters long.
errors.PASSWORD_UNCHANGED: The new password must be different from the current one.
errors.PASSWORD_CHANGED_MEANWHILE: The password was changed meanwhile, perhaps from another device. Log in again.
errors.REQUEST_INVALID: Some data is not valid. Check the fields and try again.
errors.REQUEST_TOO_LARGE: The data sent is too large.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: The change was refused: the data would not be consistent.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.CONFLICT: The data changed meanwhile. Reload the page and try again.
errors.HTTP_ERROR: The server answered with an error.
errors.NETWORK: The server cannot be reached. Check the connection and try again.
errors.SERVER: The server had a problem. Try again in a moment.
errors.QUANTITY_CONFLICT: The change was refused: a quantity would become negative.
errors.CURRENCY_MISMATCH: A transaction can move only to an account with the same currency.
errors.ISIN_ALREADY_USED: You already have a security with this ISIN.

login.heading: Log in
login.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask the administrator to reset it.

firstRun.heading: Welcome
firstRun.intro: First start: the app is empty. What would you like to do?
firstRun.restoreUnavailable: Restoring from a backup will be available in a later version.

createAdmin.heading: Create the administrator
createAdmin.intro: The administrator is the first user and manages the others.
createAdmin.usernameHint: 3 to 32 characters: letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore.
createAdmin.languageIntro: The language of the app for the administrator. Each user can change it in Settings.

forcedChange.heading: Change your temporary password
forcedChange.intro: You logged in with a temporary password. Choose a new one to continue.

validation.usernamePattern: Use 3 to 32 characters: letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.
validation.passwordMin: The password must be at least {{min}} characters long.
validation.passwordsDiffer: The two passwords do not match.
validation.isinFormat: An ISIN has 12 characters: 2 letters, 9 letters or digits, then a digit.
validation.isinCheck: This ISIN is not valid: its last digit does not match. Check for a typing mistake.

dashboard.heading: Dashboard
dashboard.placeholder: The dashboard arrives in a later step of this version.

about.heading: About
about.licenseText: GNU Affero General Public License v3 (AGPL-3.0-only). If you offer the app over a network, you must make its source code available.

notFound.heading: Page not found
notFound.text: This address does not match any page of the app.

accounts.heading: Accounts
accounts.intro_one: {{count}} account · “Open” sets the account in view and opens the dashboard.
accounts.intro_other: {{count}} accounts · “Open” sets the account in view and opens the dashboard.
accounts.partialNote: Partial: an exchange rate is missing, so part of the value is left out.
accounts.staleFx: The {{pair}} exchange rate is from {{date}}: it has not been updated recently.
accounts.reportingValue: Value in {{currency}} at the latest available rate: {{value}}
accounts.reportingStale: Value in {{currency}} at the rate of {{date}}, not updated recently: {{value}}
accounts.reportingMissing: Value in {{currency}} not available: the exchange rate is missing.
accounts.emptyText: An account has one cash currency, like an account at a broker. Create one to start adding holdings and transactions.

accountForm.intro: An account has one cash currency: for more currencies, use more accounts.
accountForm.name: Name
accountForm.currencyNote: The currency cannot be changed after the first transaction.
accountForm.currencyLocked: Fixed: the account already has transactions.
accountForm.externalCodeHint: Saved by the first Directa import; it picks this account for the next files.

deleteAccount.heading: Delete the account “{{name}}”?
deleteAccount.text_zero: It has no transactions. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.text_one: Its {{count}} transaction will be deleted too. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.text_other: Its {{count}} transactions will be deleted too. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.archive: If you only want to hide it, that is not possible yet: archiving arrives in a later version.
deleteAccount.confirm: Type the account name to confirm

routeError.heading: Something went wrong
routeError.text: The page could not be shown. Reload it; if it happens again, tell the administrator.
routeError.updatedText: The app was updated while this page was open. Reload to continue.

issues.not_allowed: This field does not apply to this type of transaction.
issues.must_be_positive: Enter a number greater than zero.
issues.must_not_be_negative: Enter zero or a positive number.
issues.too_many_digits: The computed amount has too many digits: type the amount shown by your broker.
issues.invariant: The total does not match the other amounts.
issues.mismatch: This security does not match the transaction.
issues.invalid_asset: This security's settings are not consistent: check its type and price unit.
issues.must_match_asset_type: Bonds, and only bonds, are priced as a % of nominal.

transactions.heading: Transactions
transactions.caption: Transactions, rows {{first}}–{{last}} of {{total}}
transactions.pageEmpty: This page has no rows: the list is shorter now.
transactions.emptyText: Transactions you add appear here, newest first.
transactions.noAccounts: Transactions belong to an account: create one first.
transactions.selectPage: Select every row of this page
transactions.deleteAll: Delete all transactions of this security…

transactionForm.intro: Record a movement by hand. You enter the taxes yourself: the app does not calculate them.
transactionForm.grossHint: Computed from quantity × price. Type it only to match your broker's statement exactly.
transactionForm.grossForeign: The security is quoted in {{quote}}: type the amount in {{currency}} from your broker's statement.
transactionForm.accruedHint: Moves cash and counts as income, never as cost.
transactionForm.taxesHint: As on the statement: positive if withheld, negative (with −) for a credit.
transactionForm.taxesBuyHint: Bonds only: usually negative (with −), a credit on accrued interest or issue discount.
transactionForm.noCashHint: The security enters the portfolio but the account's cash stays as it is (useful for securities already held or transferred).
transactionForm.noBonds: No bonds yet: coupons are paid by bonds only.
transactionForm.taxesWithheldHint: As on the statement; leave it empty if there are none.
transactionForm.dividendQuantityHint: Optional, for reference only: the number of shares the dividend was paid on.
transactionForm.ratioHint: 2 new for 1 old doubles the quantity; 1 new for 10 old is a reverse split.
transactionForm.grossRecomputed: Computed again from quantity × price, because one of them changed. Type it only to match your broker's statement exactly.
transactionForm.pricesLookedUp: Automatic prices for this ISIN are being looked up.
transactionForm.grossForeignAgain: The quantity, price or security changed: type the amount in {{currency}} again from your broker's statement.

typeHints.BUY: Buy a security: the quantity grows, the average cost is updated and the cash goes down.
typeHints.SELL: Sell a security: the quantity goes down, the average cost stays and the cash goes up.
typeHints.DIVIDEND: A dividend received: gross amount and taxes withheld.
typeHints.COUPON: A bond coupon received: gross amount and taxes withheld.
typeHints.WITHDRAWAL: Money taken out of the account.
typeHints.STOCK_SPLIT: A split or reverse split: the quantity changes, the cost stays.

input.invalid: Not a number: use digits and one decimal separator.
input.tooLarge: At most 15 digits before the decimal separator.

summary.heading: Summary
summary.incomplete: Fill in the details to see the figures.
summary.note: Preview computed by the app; it updates as you type. Nothing is saved until you press “Save”.
summary.conflictOwn: Not enough quantity: you would hold {{held}} before this transaction, and it would leave {{after}}.
summary.conflictOther: A later transaction of this security would be left without enough quantity: {{held}} held before it, {{after}} after.
summary.conflictSave: Saving is refused until the quantities add up.

warnings.NEGATIVE_CASH: The cash of {{account}} goes below zero on {{date}}.
warnings.FUTURE_DATE: The date {{date}} is in the future.
warnings.INCOME_WITHOUT_HOLDING: On {{date}} {{account}} does not hold this security.

conflict.heading: This change cannot be saved
conflict.text: It would bring the quantity of {{asset}} to {{after}}: you cannot sell more than you hold.
conflict.splitText: It would bring the quantity of {{asset}} to zero with a split.
conflict.first: First transaction in conflict: {{type}} of {{quantity}} on {{date}} (you hold {{held}}).
conflict.firstNoQuantity: First transaction in conflict: {{type}} on {{date}} (you hold {{held}}).
conflict.fixQuantity: Correct the quantity of the sale.
conflict.addHeld: Add the securities you already held before (a buy with “Do not move cash”).
conflict.editTogether: Edit several transactions together, if the error is in more than one place.

editTransaction.heading: Edit transaction
editTransaction.notFound: This transaction does not exist any more: it may have been deleted.

deleteTransaction.heading: Delete this transaction?
deleteTransaction.text: {{what}} on {{date}} · {{account}}. Positions, cash and gains are recalculated.

bulkEdit.text: The changes apply to all of them and are checked together: it is fine even if one alone would not be valid.
bulkEdit.accountMixed: The selected transactions are in accounts with different currencies: the account cannot change.
bulkEdit.cashSome: Applies to {{count}} of {{total}}: deposits, withdrawals and splits do not have this option.
bulkEdit.cashNone: None of the selected transactions has this option.
bulkEdit.notesHint: Empty: the notes stay as they are.
bulkEdit.nothing: Nothing to change: choose at least one value different from the current one.

bulkDelete.text: The selected transactions are deleted together, and positions, cash and gains are recalculated. If a later transaction would be left without enough quantity, nothing is deleted and we explain why.

deleteAll.heading: Delete all transactions of a security?
deleteAll.text_one: {{asset}} · {{account}} · {{count}} transaction. Use it to start again when the history of a security is wrong.
deleteAll.text_other: {{asset}} · {{account}} · {{count}} transactions. Use it to start again when the history of a security is wrong.
deleteAll.what: Buys, sales, dividends, coupons and splits of this security in this account are deleted. This cannot be undone.
deleteAll.confirm: Type the name of the security to confirm

assetForm.heading: New security
assetForm.intro: Useful for bonds, funds or securities the price sources do not know. Without an ISIN you enter its prices yourself.
assetForm.name: Name
assetForm.isinHint: With an ISIN the app looks for automatic prices.
assetForm.unitBond: Bonds are always priced as a % of nominal.
